title: DECODE R2236, 'Copie No 1' and 'Copie No 2': Dutch number-cipher copies, KHA The Hague, Prins Willem V inv. 337 (catalogue 218)

steps.what: Fetched R2236, R2237, R2239 metadata and 14 images with the session cookie.

R2236 viewed against the R2237/R2239 word list: its numbers run to about 390 (and 2835 on one page), past the ~250-entry list, and its clear words are Dutch, not French. Not the same list; not transcribed.
Split under the one-key rule from hereditary1796: R2236 is in another list, so it is its own entry, attempted and open.
Images re-fetched with the DECODE cookie for the site crop (copy No 1, upper half).

outcome.method_basis: Viewed but not transcribed: the numbers run past the only known list (R2237's, French) and the clear words are Dutch; no list or decipherment for it was found.

gaps.item: Copie No 1, Copie No 2 and the page of numbers to 2835
gaps.detail: a different list from the R2237/R2239 French one; no list or decipherment found on the record, in the file or in print

outcome.notes: Split on 14 Oct 2026 from hereditary1796 (R2239, read with the R2237 list). Lead: de Leeuw, Cryptologia 25 (2001), on Euler's ciphers at William V's court, not seen.

prior.where: no decipherment on the record; not searched in print

human: Project-level: DECODE login cookie supplied, target posed with /goal; the user asked mid-session to push further toward a full reading.
